method: Independent direct HTTP status, redirect, media-type, byte-length and content-hash checks; page-level review of the PSA FY2025 results and Halifax factsheet PDFs; direct PSA and Temasek page review for ownership, legal history, footprint and the 2026 Temasek portfolio-management reorganization

verifiedClaims: PSA International is headquartered at PSA Horizons in Singapore
PSA International is the global strategic and investment holding company for the PSA group
Temasek reports a 100% PSA International shareholding as at March 31, 2026
Temasek classifies PSA International as a Singapore-based Temasek Portfolio Company
PSA reported 2025 revenue of S$8,264 million and operating profit of S$1,419 million
PSA reported operations in 45 countries at more than 180 locations and more than 70 terminals
The current PSA network lists Ashcroft Terminal and PSA Halifax in Canada and PSA Penn Terminals in the United States
No Mexico port operation is listed
Four North American physical terminal or inland-terminal operations are identified when PSA Halifax's two terminals are counted separately
PSA Halifax comprises the Atlantic Hub and Fairview Cove terminals in Nova Scotia
PSA Corporation succeeded the statutory authority on October 1, 1997 as a wholly owned Temasek subsidiary, while regulatory functions moved to the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore
PSA International was established in December 2003 as the main PSA Group holding company
Temasek Singapore began managing Singapore-based Temasek Portfolio Companies on April 1, 2026
The announcement describes a portfolio-management and organizational change, not a PSA International share transfer
Singapore's Minister for Finance is Temasek's sole shareholder
Temasek operates independently on a commercial basis

exitSearch.result: No PSA International-level sale, listing, partial privatization, dilution, exit or signed ownership transfer was found. Temasek's March 31, 2026 portfolio disclosure still reports 100% ownership. The April 2026 Temasek Singapore change concerns portfolio management and oversight rather than a disclosed transfer of PSA International shares.

responseSourceHealthCorrections: The four-operation North American terminal indicator is a direct network-enumeration inference, not a separately reported PSA regional metric.
PSA BDP is a global logistics subsidiary headquartered in Philadelphia and is not counted as a physical port terminal or a standalone Temasek holding.
North America-only throughput, revenue and EBITDA are not publicly disclosed.

The immediate registered-shareholder consequence, if any, of the April 2026 Temasek portfolio-management reorganization is not publicly disclosed; it does not disturb Temasek's reported 100% economic ownership.
